property_summary: For any caller, calling renounceOwnership succeeds if and only if that caller is the contract's current owner; the mutant removes the onlyOwner check, so any non-owner caller can renounce and become an ownership change that P always reverts.
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone (not just the owner) can call transferOwnership and change the owner.
